Download Dream League Soccer 2025 Mod Apk Obb which has real player faces, classic players, increased squad size, improved graphics, new season theme graphics and more. 

Dream League Soccer 2025 allows you to manage your dream team of over 4000 licenced FIFPro players, play against world best soccer clubs, also pass through 8 divisions while enjoying improved game play to win the trophy at the end of the season. 

In DLS 2025 Mod for Android you can sign available top players during transfers season, which will help in improving your football squad, you can players such as Messi, Mpappe, C. Ronaldo, Muhammed  Salah and many more star players available within the game. 

New season themed user interface has been added to this year Dream League Soccer 2025, you also get to experience each players special skills such as, dribbling, score accuracy, improved energy, bicycle kicks to score and many more. 

Ability to customise players kits by adding kits such the one of Real Madrid, Barcelona DLS kits etc, this will improve the appearance of your dream team.

  • Mod Menu
